# GitHub Social Preview — Dejavu

**语言中立：** tagline 与 prompt 不得出现编程语言名、logo、后缀或典型语法片段。

**品牌色暂定 Terracotta**（`#DF5B3B` / `#708067`），待产品拍板。

File: [`social-preview.jpg`](./social-preview.jpg) — **1280×640**, target &lt; 500 KB (must be **&lt; 1 MB**).

## Upload

1. [Settings → Social preview](https://github.com/doki-land/dejavu-language/settings#social-preview)
2. Upload **`.github/social-preview.jpg`**

|------|-------|
| Size | 1280×640 (2:1，GenerateImage 后 cover 裁切) |

```
Ultra-wide banner, central 89% safe zone for 2:1 crop. Warm paper #f4f0e6, terracotta #DF5B3B, moss #708067.
```
